description:
Easy mode available
https://play.unity.com/mg/other/vs-monsters-easy-mode
[Game TIPs]
- This game has FIVE STAGES.
- Monsters are spawned NOT randomly. Remember spawned order.
- Weapons or protections are hidden in each stage.
- Stay calm, your shield will recover. some trees do it rapidly.
- Be careful. Red monster can jump but some protections can do it bouncing back.

Defeat monsters and defend villages.
This game has sound. Please volume on.
This game is my first project game.
